notes.title: Moonless Knight release date!
notes.notes:
October 31st 2019.

Yes, in two months.

I could release early October but I rather make sure I polish it up as much as possible. 
It already contains more options and comfort settings than all 3 of my games combined, which is hard as the engine can be a total headache.

Overall this game will feature the widest spectrum of gameplay styles of my games yet, with the absolute most open structure yet. More open than basically any Metroidvania, but not falling over the edge into open world.

Please look forward to the release and make sure to wishlist it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029170/Skautfold_Moonless_Knight/

It has been a really hard time for me both due to financial difficulties and struggling with depression, still I feel like this will be by far my best work yet.

notes.title: 1.0 Release. Post launch plans outlined.
notes.notes:
The game is now officially out of Early Access.


However there will be further content updates in the coming days and weeks.

First of all more optional missions, more masks, additional modes, and like with both Shrouded in Sanity and Usurper, different playable characters down the line. Into the Fray was built to be a lot more scale-able than Usurper was so adding content is a lot more easy.


The game should be bug-free, all currently reported bugs were eliminated, in case of any bugs however please report them in as much detail as possible and I will fix them asap.


I would like to thank everyone who brought the Early Access version and reported bugs, and/or provided feedback.


Hope you'll enjoy the game.

Steve.

notes.title: Into the Fray release date set.
notes.notes:
December 5th.

Into the Fray will be leaving Early Access on the 5th of December.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/893610/Skautfold_Into_the_Fray/

The game is a direct sequel to both Shrouded in Sanity and Usurper, and features Hito the 3rd Knight as the protagonist.

The game will receive post launch support in the form of more modes and silly extras, but the release version will already feature a lot of extras. Like the obvious Steam stuff like Achievements and Trading cards.

Once out of EA development on the next game begins immediately, while ItF will receive periodic smaller additions to tie over. No DLC plans. If you are interested in the 4th game in the series you can always pop into our Discord and take a look and have your say, discord users had a lot of influence on me over the last game.

Additionally Christmas will bring a nice surprise regarding Usurper if everything goes well, as a thank you to all who support my weird series of games with different genres each time.

notes.title: Update #12
notes.notes:
Changed:


-Drastic fundamental change as to how map flushing is handled, the issue is that GMS sometimes fails to operate at a basic level, this meant that when restarting a dungeon or leaving it sometimes the built in functions would not work. So some rooms would retain data and cause a massive bug possibly blocking completion until its restarted.

So I tried a different method and here we are, now upon restarting or leaving a dungeon the game will secretly restart ensuring ALL data is flushed, this took a while to implement but now its working and should prevent this bug from ever occurring again.

This might cause unknown bugs so please be on the lookout for data not saving etc.


Fixed:


-Asylum remained locked off in some cases. 

-Asylum lifts would not direct properly.

-Scene transition fade out was missing in some scenes.

-Morale gained warning appeared in inappropriate places, now fixed.

-Flamethrower full auto fire still had the parenting bug resulting in enemies going off to fight invisible things.
